verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Amrafel vwọ ovie ri Shinar, Ariọk ke ovie re Elasai, Chedor-laomer kẹ ovie rẹ Elam, Tidal kẹ ovie ri Goiim,
verses.text_romanized: oke re amrafel vwo ovie ri shinar ariok ke ovie re elasai chedor laomer ke ovie re elam tidal ke ovie ri goiim

verses.text_urhobo: ivie nana da kpare ofovwi bru Bera ovie ri Sodọm, Birsha ovie ri Gomora, Shinab ovie rẹ Adma, Shimeba ovie ri Zeboim, kugbe ovie ri Bẹla (kọye Zoar)
verses.text_romanized: ivie nana da kpare ofovwi bru bera ovie ri sodom birsha ovie ri gomora shinab ovie re adma shimeba ovie ri zeboim kugbe ovie ri bela koye zoar

verses.text_urhobo: Enana ejobi da rhe ghwẹ koko vwẹ ushekpotọ ri Sidim (kọye urhie rẹ ughweri).
verses.text_romanized: enana ejobi da rhe ghwe koko vwe ushekpoto ri sidim koye urhie re ughweri

verses.text_urhobo: Ikpe ihwivẹ soso ọye ayen ga Chedor-laomer, ẹkẹvuọvo ikpe rẹ ihwerha re, ophu de rhi mu ayen kpahọ.
verses.text_romanized: ikpe ihwive soso oye ayen ga chedor laomer ekevuovo ikpe re ihwerha re ophu de rhi mu ayen kpaho

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ikpe ihwẹne rẹ Chedor-laomer kugbe ivie re vẹ ọye gba obọ na da rhe re họnre Rifem vwi Ashterof-karnaim, Zuzim vwi Ham, Emim vwi Shaveh-kiria-taim,
verses.text_romanized: vwe ikpe ihwene re chedor laomer kugbe ivie re ve oye gba obo na da rhe re honre rifem vwi ashterof karnaim zuzim vwi ham emim vwi shaveh kiria taim

verses.text_urhobo: kugbe Họr vwẹ ugbenu ri Seir re te Elparan rọ hẹ ughwru rẹ aton na;
verses.text_romanized: kugbe hor vwe ugbenu ri seir re te elparan ro he ughwru re aton na

verses.text_urhobo: ayen da rhoma rhe ri te Enmish-pat (kọye Kadẹsh) ayen da ghwọrọ aghwa rẹ Amalẹk ejobi kugbe aghwa rẹ Amọr re dia Haz-azon-tamar.
verses.text_romanized: ayen da rhoma rhe ri te enmish pat koye kadesh ayen da ghworo aghwa re amalek ejobi kugbe aghwa re amor re dia haz azon tamar

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ovie ri Sodọm, ovie ri Gomora, ovie ri Adma, ovie ri Zeboim, kugbe ovie ri Bẹla (kọye Zoar), ayen da yan phia ra gbara oma vwẹ ushekpotọ ri Sidim
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ovie ri sodom ovie ri gomora ovie ri adma ovie ri zeboim kugbe ovie ri bela koye zoar ayen da yan phia ra gbara oma vwe ushekpoto ri sidim

verses.text_urhobo: vi Chedor-laomer ovie ri Elam, Tidal ovie ri Goiim, Amrafel ovie ri Shinar, kugbe Ariọk ovie rẹ Elasar, ivie ẹne so iyori
verses.text_romanized: vi chedor laomer ovie ri elam tidal ovie ri goiim amrafel ovie ri shinar kugbe ariok ovie re elasar ivie ene so iyori

verses.text_urhobo: Ushekpotọ ri Sidim na vọnre vẹ egọdọ ri mu avwrogbo, ọke rẹ ivie ri Sodọm vi Gomora vwọ djẹ re, ẹvo de she phihọ egọdọ na, iri chekọ da djẹ kpo obo ugbenu.
verses.text_romanized: ushekpoto ri sidim na vonre ve egodo ri mu avwrogbo oke re ivie ri sodom vi gomora vwo dje re evo de she phiho egodo na iri cheko da dje kpo obo ugbenu

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ivwighrẹ na da ghwẹ ekuakua ri Sodọm vi Gomora reyọ, kugbe emuọre rayen ejobi ayen da yanran kpo,
verses.text_romanized: koye ivwighre na da ghwe ekuakua ri sodom vi gomora reyo kugbe emuore rayen ejobi ayen da yanran kpo

verses.text_urhobo: ayen ji mu Lọt rhe, ọmọ rẹ oniọvo rẹ Ebram, rọ dia Sodọm, vẹ eyenre rọye, ayen de kpo.
verses.text_romanized: ayen ji mu lot rhe omo re oniovo re ebram ro dia sodom ve eyenre roye ayen de kpo

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ọvo vwẹ usun rẹ ayen re djẹ vabọ da rhe, re vuẹ Ebram ri Hibru na, rọ dia kẹrẹ ọhahe ri Mamre rẹ ohwo ri Amọr, oniọvo rẹ Eskol kugbe Aner, enana vẹ Ebraham kẹ obọ.
verses.text_romanized: koye ovo vwe usun re ayen re dje vabo da rhe re vue ebram ri hibru na ro dia kere ohahe ri mamre re ohwo ri amor oniovo re eskol kugbe aner enana ve ebraham ke obo

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Ebram vwo nyo nẹ emu omoni rọye ighuvwun, o de sun otu rẹ ofovwi rọye phia rọ nabọ yono, re ji vwiẹ vwẹ uwevwi rọye, uri gbẹ ujori, gbẹ ihwe gbẹ ẹrenre, ayen da vwọ tua ayen rhi te Dan.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ebram vwo nyo ne emu omoni roye ighuvwun o de sun otu re ofovwi roye phia ro nabo yono re ji vwie vwe uwevwi roye uri gbe ujori gbe ihwe gbe erenre ayen da vwo tua ayen rhi te dan

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ason re ayen da ghare oma, te ọye vẹ idibo rọye, ayen de ke ayen phihọ, ayen da vwọ tua ayen re te Hobah, rọ obenu ri Damaskọs.
verses.text_romanized: vwe ason re ayen da ghare oma te oye ve idibo roye ayen de ke ayen phiho ayen da vwo tua ayen re te hobah ro obenu ri damaskos

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin o de mie ayen eyenre na ejobi, ọ da reyọ Lọt omoni rọye vẹ eyenre rọye, kugbe eya na vẹ ihwo na ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin o de mie ayen eyenre na ejobi o da reyo lot omoni roye ve eyenre roye kugbe eya na ve ihwo na ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Ro vwo rhivwi rhe nu ro vwo phi Chedor-laomer, kugbe ivie re vẹ ọye gba obọ kparobọ nu, ovie ri Sodọm da yanran ra vwa vwẹ ushekpotọ ri Shaveh (kọye ese ushekpotọ rẹ Ovie).
verses.text_romanized: ro vwo rhivwi rhe nu ro vwo phi chedor laomer kugbe ivie re ve oye gba obo kparobo nu ovie ri sodom da yanran ra vwa vwe ushekpoto ri shaveh koye ese ushekpoto re ovie

verses.text_urhobo: Melkizẹdẹk ovie ri Salẹm da vwẹ ọkuọka vi wain vwo rhe, ọye orherẹn rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ro Me Kpenu.
verses.text_romanized: melkizedek ovie ri salem da vwe okuoka vi wain vwo rhe oye orheren re oghene ro me kpenu

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ tanẹ, Ebruba kẹ Ebram vwẹ oma rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ro Me Kpenu, rọ ma odjuvwu vẹ akpọ;
verses.text_romanized: o da ne erhovwo ke tane ebruba ke ebram vwe oma re oghene ro me kpenu ro ma odjuvwu ve akpo

verses.text_urhobo: Ebruba kẹ Ọghẹnẹ ro Me Kpenu, rọ reyọ ivwighrẹ wẹn phihọ owẹ obọ. Ebram da vwẹ ẹkẹn ihwe rẹ ekuakua na ejobi kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ebruba ke oghene ro me kpenu ro reyo ivwighre wen phiho owe obo ebram da vwe eken ihwe re ekuakua na ejobi ke

verses.text_urhobo: Ovie ri Sodọm da ta kẹ, Ebram, Vwẹ ihwo na kẹ vwẹ, ẹkẹvuọvo gba reyọ ekuakua na kẹ oma wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: ovie ri sodom da ta ke ebram vwe ihwo na ke vwe ekevuovo gba reyo ekuakua na ke oma wen

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Ebram da ta kẹ ovie ri Sodọm, Mi vẹ kẹ Ọrovwohwo Ọghẹnẹ ro Me Kpenu nure, ọ rọ ma odjuvwu vẹ akpọ,
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ebram da ta ke ovie ri sodom mi ve ke orovwohwo oghene ro me kpenu nure o ro ma odjuvwu ve akpo

verses.text_urhobo: nẹ Me sa reyọ ogẹ rẹ oruru-u, eyẹ ufi rẹ isabatoo, eyẹ kemu kemu rọ dia ọwẹ-ẹn, wọ da rha tanẹ, Mẹvwẹ nẹrhẹ Ebram fe.
verses.text_romanized: ne me sa reyo oge re oruru u eye ufi re isabatoo eye kemu kemu ro dia owe en wo da rha tane mevwe nerhe ebram fe

verses.text_urhobo: Me sa reyọ emuọvo-o jokpa rẹ emu rẹ emeshare mẹ na rere, kugbe ẹkẹn rẹ ihwo ri nene uvwe, jẹn Aner, Eskol, kugbe Mamre reyọ ẹkẹn rayen.
verses.text_romanized: me sa reyo emuovo o jokpa re emu re emeshare me na rere kugbe eken re ihwo ri nene uvwe jen aner eskol kugbe mamre reyo eken rayen
